$comment: Every node and mark the Folium editor's schema permits.
This file is the contract between the editor and the Markdown converters, and
it is checked from both sides:
frontend/src/components/editor/editorSchema.test.ts  asserts the editor's
real extension list produces exactly these names. Enable a new TipTap
extension and that test fails until this file is updated.
backend/tests/test_editor_parity.py  asserts every name here is either
converted by app/utils/import_file.py or listed in `excluded` below with a
reason. Update this file and that test fails until a decision is made.
Phase 6-i exists because that loop did not: StarterKit enabled blockquote and
codeBlock from the beginning, the converter skipped unknown blocks silently,
and a document made of a quote exported as an empty file.
`lossy` records formatting the editor supports that Markdown CANNOT carry.
This is a deliberate policy change, not an oversight: TipTap JSON is the
storage format and the record of truth, Markdown is one export among
several, and requiring Markdown parity capped the editor at what Markdown
can express. Colour, fonts and alignment have no Markdown spelling.
What must never happen is losing them SILENTLY, which is the exact bug
shape that bit three times in Phase 6. So: the export dialog warns before
writing a .md file that omits them, PDF export keeps all of it, and
test_editor_parity.py asserts each drops CLEANLY — the text survives and
only the formatting goes.

excluded.doc: The document root itself, not content within it.
excluded.text: Carries the characters every other rule renders; not a block or a mark.
excluded.listItem: Rendered by its parent bulletList or orderedList, never on its own.
excluded.taskItem: Rendered by its parent taskList, never on its own.
excluded.tableRow: Rendered by its parent table, never on its own.
excluded.tableCell: Rendered by its parent tableRow, never on its own.
excluded.tableHeader: Rendered by its parent tableRow, never on its own.

lossy.textStyle: Colour, font size and font family. Markdown has no spelling for any of them.
lossy.textAlign: An attribute on heading and paragraph. Markdown cannot express alignment at all.
lossy.highlight.color: The mark itself exports as <mark> and survives; which colour it was does not, so a yellow and a pink highlight come back identical.
